text: Governing Board Member, Fountain Valley School District

As an educator for 31 years and current President of the Fountain Valley School Board, I work to serve students and families. I have been a teacher, school principal, Director of Education, and currently serve as Chief of Staff for the Orange County Department of Education. Utilizing my area of expertise, I have helped to build solid, thriving school communities.
During my four years as a Governing Board Member, I have placed a major emphasis on:
Safe schools and healthy, happy kids - installed perimeter fencing to further enhance our school safety
High academic standards propelling our students to rank first in reading, math, and science in Orange County
Expanding STEM, the arts, and music opportunities for students
Fiscal responsibility, ensuring yearly that FVSD has a positive financial certification with stable and sustainable budgets

I continue to serve our community on the Board of Directors for Fountain Valley Schools Foundation, Orange County Sheriff’s Advisory Council, Junior Achievement Orange County, and Coastline College Foundation.
My wife and I have raised five children in Fountain Valley and have been foster parents for 11 children. We work together, as a family, to help our city and our schools be a great place for everyone.
I look forward to your vote.

text: School Principal/Parent
I am grateful to call Fountain Valley home and am committed to ensuring our schools remain among the very best for every child.

For 23 years, I have dedicated my career to public education. I began as a classified instructional aide later serving as a special education teacher, athletic coach, assistant principal, and, currently, a middle school principal. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of what students, teachers, and families need to succeed. My passion for quality education is why I want to serve.

Our three children attend Fountain Valley schools because my wife and I believe in the strength of this community and the top-notch quality of its schools. I am an active PTA member, Assistant Scoutmaster, coach of youth sport teams, and a strong advocate for family partnerships in students’ education.
As your Trustee, I will prioritize:
Student and campus safety
Maintaining high academic standards for all students
Attracting and retaining highly qualified teachers and staff
Ensuring fiscal responsibility
Promoting local control of education

Vote for me, and together we can preserve what makes Fountain Valley schools exceptional, while supporting the dedicated educators who serve our children and ensuring every student is prepared for a successful future.

text: Math Teacher/Parent

As a former Fountain Valley School District student, proud parent of two former FVSD students, and recently retired high school math teacher, I bring a unique perspective to our schools—as a student, a parent, and an educator who understands what students need to succeed in high school and beyond.

I have long admired FVSD’s caring teachers, engaged families, strong neighborhood schools, and tradition of helping students grow academically, socially, and personally. I am running because I want to contribute to that success and help ensure FVSD continues to thrive for every student.

With 30 years of classroom experience and a Master’s Degree in Mathematics, I have dedicated my career to improving student outcomes and supporting great teaching. As your trustee, I will prioritize student safety, mental wellbeing, strong academics, appropriate class sizes, more school counselors, and meaningful professional development for teachers.

I will listen to parents, value community and professional input, and work to build consensus around a strong 21st-century education for every child. I will also champion transparency, fiscal responsibility, and careful oversight of taxpayer dollars.
I respectfully ask for your vote.
Please feel free to contact me: Carl4FVSDTrustee@gmail.com, 714-907-1740, or at CarlBlankenhorn.com.
